variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: The company {company} has laid off many workers. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
